_meta.source: Synthetic 'standard' router-class machine, 2026-10-10. Not a real machine; a moderate counterpart to machine_example_xyz.json for spectrum testing. Never use as platform defaults.
_meta.units_as_reported: velocity mm/s, acceleration and deceleration mm/s^2, jerk mm/s^3 (same keys as machine_example_xyz.json)
design: Deceleration within 25% of acceleration (example machine: 10x lower).
Rest to full speed in hundreds of milliseconds: X/Y 200 mm/s at 1500 mm/s^2, J 30000 -> ~0.18 s; Z 50 mm/s at 800 mm/s^2, J 20000 -> ~0.10 s.
All axes accelerationProfile 2 (S-curve); profile-0 variants are derived in tests/machines.py.
